done_when: The worker brief (src/forge/templates/brief.md) says a change to documentation only needs no test, and that in a repo whose tests run Forge (forge-source) a test runs the forge command and never imports forge; a test pins both lines
why: Workers keep breaking two unwritten rules: they add a test for a docs-only change that nothing runs (trial client PR 1), and they import forge in tests instead of running the forge command (PRs 298, 304, 317), each costing a failed round
